game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Spirit Stream, a stream of spirits: the druid must handle thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Spirit Stream: a stream of spirits
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Expression statements: build a valid C source file that prints 33. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the router at (2, 3), with the upper processing path on row 0 and lower path on row 6. IF item value >= 21, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Finish both paths at their separate output depots. Deliver exactly 13 components (7 upper, 6 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 13.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Loop Picker' (Week 5 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Spirit Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

source_player_objective: Reach the vine bridge using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The vine bridge reached with actions_used <= 14.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the vine bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
